task_completion.description: GeoGebra is launched and the 3D Graphics view is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoGebra application window is visible showing a 3D coordinate system (x, y, z axes).

task_completion.description: Vectors u = (1, 2, -2) and v = (3, 0, 1) are defined in the Algebra view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Algebra sidebar shows definitions for u=(1, 2, -2) and v=(3, 0, 1) with corresponding arrows in the 3D view.

task_completion.description: The cross product vector (2, -7, -6) is calculated and displayed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A third vector (often labeled 'w' or 'u × v') appears in the Algebra view with coordinates (2, -7, -6) and is rendered in the 3D view.

task_completion.description: The parallelogram spanned by vectors u and v is visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A shaded quadrilateral (parallelogram) formed by u and v is visible in the 3D graphics window.

task_completion.description: A text label showing the result or magnitude/area is present in the 3D view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text box or label is visible in the graphics area displaying the cross product coordinates (2, -7, -6) or the area value (approx 9.43).

task_completion.description: The project is saved with the correct filename in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoGebra title bar shows 'cross_product_3d.ggb' or a 'Save As' dialog is seen pointing to ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoGebra GUI to create the visualization rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the GeoGebra input bar, tools, or menus.

integrity.description: The cross product and area were generated by GeoGebra functions, not just static text boxes.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Algebra view shows dependent objects (like 'CrossProduct(u, v)') rather than just independent text strings.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open an existing file with the solution.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step input of coordinates and construction of the geometric elements.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Vector u is (1, 2, -2). Vector v is (3, 0, 1). The resulting cross product vector must be (2, -7, -6). The magnitude of this vector (and the area of the parallelogram) is sqrt(89) ≈ 9.434. The file must be named 'cross_product_3d.ggb' and saved in '~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/'.
